title: What If Brands Pay Target to Reach You?
description:
What if your Target app's ads were worth almost a billion dollars?

Sources:
- Target Q4 and full-year 2025 earnings release: https://corporate.target.com/press/release/2026/03/target-corporation-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-earnings

scenes.narration: What if your Target app's ads were worth almost a billion dollars?
They actually are. Brands pay Target to reach you, through Roundel.
Its ad revenue jumped from 649 million dollars to 915 million.
But store credit cards? Another 522 million in shared profits.
Shelves bring you in. But the side businesses keep adding up.

sources.title: Target Q4 and full-year 2025 earnings release
